testFixtureCorrection.problem: A permanent constant Math.random override caused worker message ID collisions, exposed by the new post-draw source-readiness check.
evidence: src/vendor/geoglyph-maplibre-v530-vendor.js Actor.sendAsync generates message IDs from Math.round(1e18*Math.random()).toString(36).substring(0,10) and stores promise handlers in resolveRejects[id].
Repeated IDs overwrite handlers; processing one response deletes its entry, leaving other concurrent promises unresolved.
GeoJSONSource._updateWorkerData increments _pendingLoads, awaits actor.sendAsync(LD), and decrements after completion. loaded() requires _pendingLoads === 0.
The affected test reported The artwork did not reach the map frame; restoring normal randomness before asynchronous drawing makes it pass.
testFixtureCorrection.fix: Seed only the synchronous Random shuffle and restore Math.random in finally before awaiting candidate preparation. Production rendering and font policies remain unchanged.
